svg.title: theophilusjohn.com
svg.desc: Five nodes with the elected one in the leader accent, the site's own motif and hard rule 2's licensed use of it. Colours are tokens: the void tile, the dim followers, the leader. Token names are written bare because an XML comment may not contain a double hyphen and this file is parsed as XML, not as HTML: with the usual custom-property spelling it does not parse at all, and a browser renders nothing rather than complaining.
